1.title: Exam Technique and Final Review
1.text: Welcome to Module fifteen: Exam Technique and Final Review. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do four things. Exam technique. Product-to-job map. Easily confused pairs. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Scope: All domains (final review). Exam format: forty-five minutes; a score of seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand passes. Validated against: the official S C nine hundred study guide, skills measured as of October twenty-one, two thousand twenty-six.

1.title: Exam technique
1.text: Exam technique. Read the last line first (what is asked), then the scenario. Find the keyword: "if-then at sign-in" equals Conditional Access; "just in time" equals P I M; "shadow I T" equals Defender for Cloud Apps. Eliminate products from the wrong family (a firewall does not label documents). Two similar answers? Ask: identity, network, threat, data or compliance? Interactive items: drag-and-drop and match lists use the same facts as multiple choice. Manage time: forty-five minutes; do not stay on one item; mark and return. You need seven hundred of one thousand to pass; unanswered items count as wrong, so always answer.

1.title: Easily confused pairs
1.text: Easily confused pairs. Secure score versus compliance score. Posture (Defender) versus regulatory improvement actions (Purview). Entra roles versus Azure R B A C. Identity resources versus Azure resources. Sign-in risk versus user risk. This login versus this account. N S G versus Azure Firewall. Simple rules per subnet versus central managed firewall. Content explorer versus activity explorer. What and where versus what happened. Retention policy versus label. Broad versus per item. Defender X D R versus Defender for Cloud. Workplace threat protection versus cloud workload posture and protection. Information barriers versus communication compliance. Prevent contact versus review messages.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. Fabrikam Outdoors wants administrators to hold roles only when needed, with approval and M F A at activation. Which tool? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Privileged Identity Management. P I M provides just-in-time role activation with approval and M F A.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. A company wants a score of its Azure configuration against recommendations. Which tool? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Defender for Cloud secure score. Secure score in Defender for Cloud measures posture.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. Which Zero Trust principle says to grant the minimum access needed? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Use least privilege access. Least privilege limits access to what is necessary.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Who is responsible for the data and identities of a customer in Azure sass? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: The customer. Data, endpoints, accounts and access are always the customer's responsibility.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. An analyst wants to automate a response to a Sentinel incident. What should be used? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: A playbook. Playbooks automate response.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. A user's sign-in originates in two countries within an hour. Which service flags it? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Entra I D Protection. Impossible travel is a sign-in risk detection.

1.title: Practice Question 7
1.text: Question seven. Which feature requires M F A only when users sign in from untrusted locations? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Conditional Access. Conditional Access applies if-then rules based on signals.

1.title: Practice Question 8
1.text: Question eight. Which solution applies encryption and a watermark to a document marked Confidential? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Sensitivity label. Sensitivity labels encrypt and mark content.

1.title: Practice Question 9
1.text: Question nine. Which solution produces a searchable record of administrator actions in Microsoft three sixty-five? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Microsoft Purview Audit. Audit logs user and admin activity.

1.title: Practice Question 10
1.text: Question ten. A company wants to prevent files with credit card numbers from being uploaded to external sharing. Which fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: D L P. D L P monitors and blocks sensitive data from leaving.

1.title: Practice Question 11
1.text: Question eleven. An engineer wants to store a database connection string without placing it in code. What fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Azure Key Vault. Key Vault stores secrets securely.

1.title: Practice Question 12
1.text: Question twelve. Where can a company get Microsoft's I S O twenty-seven thousand one audit report? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Service Trust Portal. The Service Trust Portal hosts audit reports.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. What is the default Defender for Cloud standard? Answer: The Microsoft cloud security benchmark. Question two. What is Microsoft Entra I D's previous name? Answer: Azure Active Directory. Question three. Pass score for S C nine hundred? Answer: seven hundred out of one thousand.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What does soar do? Answer: Automates incident response. Question five. What is the difference between eligible and active in P I M? Answer: Eligible can activate; active has the role now. Question six. Name the three Zero Trust principles. Answer: Verify explicitly, use least privilege access and assume breach.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Technique: read the question, find the keyword, eliminate, answer everything, manage forty-five minutes. Pass: seven hundred of one thousand. Domains: concepts ten to fifteen percent, Entra twenty-five to thirty percent, security solutions thirty-five to forty percent, compliance twenty to twenty-five percent. That completes the course. Good luck with the exam.
